hotspots.title: AfD’s record poll surge in Germany
hotspots.blurb: Germany’s far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) has surged to a historic 29% in YouGov polls, a nine-point lead over the CDU/CSU. The party’s rise coincides with internal controversies, including extremism allegations and legal challenges against its members.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the AfD’s unprecedented polling lead, which signals a major shift in German politics and raises alarms about the normalization of far-right ideologies in mainstream discourse.

hotspots.title: Manuel Adorni’s corruption scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: Argentina’s Cabinet Chief Manuel Adorni faces mounting allegations of illicit enrichment, including undeclared cryptocurrency holdings and inconsistencies in his asset declarations. Opposition parties are pushing for his removal via a constitutional censure motion.
hotspots.affect: This story dominates coverage due to its high-stakes implications for President Javier Milei’s government, combining moral outrage over corruption with political maneuvering and judicial scrutiny.

hotspots.blurb: President Trump announced a preliminary peace deal with Iran, including the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and the lifting of naval blockades. The deal has sparked skepticism from allies and critics, with Israel vowing to continue military operations in Lebanon.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its geopolitical significance, the high-stakes nature of U.S.-Iran relations, and the polarized reactions from global leaders and domestic critics.

hotspots.title: Jordan Bardella’s justice reform crusade
hotspots.blurb: France’s far-right leader Jordan Bardella faces backlash for attending Monaco’s Grand Prix during a national memorial for murdered child Lyhanna. Bardella has proposed sweeping judicial reforms, including life imprisonment for child predators and a specialized prosecution unit.
hotspots.affect: This story is charged due to Bardella’s controversial public appearances, the moral outrage over Lyhanna’s murder, and the polarizing nature of his proposed reforms.

hotspots.title: PP-Vox coalition deals reshape Spanish regional governments
hotspots.blurb: Spain’s conservative PP and far-right Vox are negotiating coalition agreements in Andalusia and Castilla y León, with Vox demanding policy concessions like national priority in housing and social services. The deals have sparked protests and accusations of extremism.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high-stakes nature of regional governance, the moral and ideological clashes between PP and Vox, and the broader implications for Spain’s political landscape.
